svg.title: Captured login dashboard with no connected credentials
svg.desc: Actual agent-cli interactive output captured with tmux on September 22, 2026. The dashboard reports zero credentials and offers gateway login or adding a provider account. Trailing empty terminal rows are cropped.

g.text: Press g to log in to platform.digitallyinduced.com, or a to connect a provider account.
↑↓/jk or scroll · click/enter refresh · a add · g gateway · i import · e enable/disable · d disconnect · esc/q
